description: Blocks the orchestrator from running a long-running process inline: the `review` CLI, any `--watch` flag, a build/test suite (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun test|build, pytest/vitest/jest/cypress/playwright, cargo/go test|build, make test|build|all), or `sleep N` with N>=10. Dispatch it to a BACKGROUND subagent instead. Argv-aware: the command is shell-tokenized and a long process is flagged only when the REAL invoked command (argv[0] after peeling inline env + no-op wrappers) is the runner — a keyword inside a quoted argument to a different command (tg/echo/git commit -m) never trips it; `sleep 2` passes. Subagent-exempt (agent_id present). Escape hatch: ALLOW_INLINE_PROCESS=1 + ALLOW_INLINE_PROCESS_REASON='why', or inline `# inline-process-ok: why`. on_error=open.
